anomalies.description: Chaotic street scene with multiple individuals in motion, some appearing to be running or engaged in physical struggle; police or security personnel in light uniforms are present and interacting aggressively with civilians. Visual evidence includes blurred motion consistent with rapid movement and confrontation, and the on-screen text explicitly states 'erupted into chaos in the streets'.

A large, dense crowd is in chaotic motion at night, with multiple police officers in light-colored uniforms and helmets attempting to control or disperse the group; individuals are seen pushing, moving erratically, and surrounding a vehicle, indicating collective violent unrest.

A close-up view shows a police officer in a white helmet physically engaging with at least one individual; there is visible grappling, arm contact, and apparent restraint or struggle, consistent with mutual physical combat.

A large, dense crowd is present in darkness (f0–f1), followed by armed personnel confronting or engaging with individuals/groups in a chaotic nighttime setting (f2–f15); the collective unrest, presence of weapons, and apparent confrontation suggest violent group unrest consistent with a riot.

Multiple armed individuals in military-style uniforms are shown aiming and firing long guns (rifles) in a coordinated manner; muzzle flashes or bright light bursts are visible near the weapon barrels in frames f10–f15, consistent with discharge.

Multiple armed personnel in military-style uniforms are seen aiming and firing long guns (likely rifles) in a coordinated manner at night; muzzle flash is not clearly visible due to low resolution and lighting, but the posture, weapon handling, and rapid sequence of frames (f2–f10) strongly indicate active shooting.

A person in a light blue shirt and white pants is being physically restrained and struck by multiple officers wearing helmets and uniforms; the individual appears unable to resist effectively, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

Initial phase shows mutual physical engagement between the restrained individual and at least one officer, including grappling and attempts to pull away, suggesting brief mutual combat before dominance is established.

Initial physical confrontation between officers and individuals; one officer in light shirt and helmet appears to be grappling or pushing someone holding a flag-like object, with another officer nearby observing or intervening.

Scene shifts to a wider view showing multiple individuals in uniform converging on a person on the ground near a vehicle; chaotic movement and group involvement suggest collective violent unrest or suppression of a crowd event.

Multiple uniformed officers in helmets are seen subduing and physically restraining a person on the ground near a vehicle; the individual appears helpless and is being held down, kicked, and struck while prone.

A chaotic crowd of people, including multiple uniformed officers and civilians, is engaged in close physical struggle near a vehicle at night; individuals are pushing, pulling, and falling, indicating collective violent unrest beyond simple arrest.
A person in light-colored clothing appears restrained or pinned on the ground while others surround and interact aggressively; posture suggests helplessness during part of the struggle.
Multiple individuals engaged in mutual physical combat, including grappling, striking, and pulling; visible throughout the sequence with dynamic movement and close contact.

Multiple individuals are engaged in close physical struggle; arms are raised, bodies are intertwined, and postures suggest mutual grappling or striking. A person in a yellow shirt appears to be actively involved in the scuffle.

After the initial melee, a person in a light-colored shirt is seen on the ground while others surround them; one individual appears to be leaning over and possibly striking or restraining the prone person. The victim shows no active resistance, suggesting helplessness.

Large group of people in open field engaged in chaotic, violent interactions involving multiple confrontations, scattered debris (papers), and apparent use of force by uniformed personnel against civilians — consistent with collective violent unrest.

Multiple individuals in light blue shirts (appearing to be police or security) are engaged in physical altercations with people in a crowd on open ground; visible grappling, pushing, and one person being taken to the ground.

A person is on the ground while others stand over them; in frames f2–f4, an individual appears subdued or struck down, with uniformed personnel nearby, suggesting a helpless victim being attacked or restrained excessively.
Close-up of two individuals (one in white shirt, one in dark jacket) in direct physical struggle: grabbing, pulling, and close contact indicative of mutual combat.
